experiment.baselineMeaning: FaIR reference-state balancing rates, not a claim that these rates are independently measured natural emission inventories. experiment.attributionCalculation: Annual factual surface minus annual counterfactual surface, minus that same paired member's 1850-1900 inclusive mean. Annual temperature is the mean of adjacent year boundaries. No median is taken before memberwise subtraction/rebasing.
